authentication_credentials.table: not a dedicated table — password hash presumed stored in EMPLOYEES or a table not yet scanned
authentication_credentials.mechanism: PKG_SECURITY.hash_password — package header comment explicitly states 'Password stored as MD5 hash (should be bcrypt/scrypt)'
authentication_credentials.note: MD5 is not a suitable password hash (no salt semantics guaranteed, fast to brute-force). This is a self-documented known issue in the source, not an inference.

retention_policy.classification: Documented retention default — 365 days for audit trail
retention_policy.note: No scheduler (DBMS_SCHEDULER job) confirming this runs automatically was found in scanned files — retention is a callable default, not a confirmed enforced policy. See hidden-business-rules.json.

gdpr_ccpa_relevant_gaps: No soft-delete/anonymization path evident for terminated employees' PII — TRG_EMP_INSTEAD_OF_DELETE blocks ALL physical deletes unconditionally, meaning employee PII (SSN, DOB, bank accounts, address) is retained indefinitely with no purge mechanism, which may conflict with a right-to-erasure obligation depending on jurisdiction.

EMPLOYEE_DEPENDENTS and EMERGENCY_CONTACTS store third-party PII (spouses, children, emergency contacts) with no independent consent/retention tracking — these individuals are not employees and have no login/session record of their own.
